item.title: The false monster.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Emotional

Elevator Pitch: Ok, so the skip is a snake woman that is bad. But it's not really true that she's a monster, because she has been trolled by gamer against weed. Because of that, the foundation will try to kill it because when someone sees her, the person thinks she's some kind of devil.

Central Narrative: So here's how it's going to be. She will be captured by the foundation and everyone agree that she's bad and that it should be killed. After this, the GOC saw the document and where perspective about the foundation wanting to kill it, and that they could be in some kind of memetic effect. So, a scientist is the only one that didn't see the SCP and will try to make research without having any information about the SCP.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I wanna make the reader feel confused about why the GOC/the scientist try to not kill it but in the end the reader will all understand.
